Front: Paano mag-design ng high available system?
Back: i-add ng redundancy sa lahat ng layers: servers, databases, load balancers, networks
ang passive server ay naka-standby — nagte-takeover lang kapag nag-fail ang active
lahat ng servers ay nag-handle ng traffic — mas efficient pero mas complex
periodic HTTP endpoint check: GET /health — kung hindi nag-respond, i-remove sa pool
Service Level Agreement — ang agreed uptime: 99.9% (three nines), 99.99% (four nines)
